What e-Pulse does

Capabilities that exist in the application today. Anything planned is labelled as planned on the Modules page.

Batch-wise stock, always traceable

Every movement is recorded in a stock ledger; current and batch balances are derived from it, so a figure can be traced to the documents behind it.

Details for Batch-wise stock, always traceable

Expiry-aware by design

FEFO allocation on delivery, with near-expiry and expired-stock screens to act before stock is lost.

Details for Expiry-aware by design

Order-to-cash and procure-to-pay

Orders, deliveries, invoices, credit/debit notes and returns — with over-return protection on returns.

Details for Order-to-cash and procure-to-pay

GST-aware documents

HSN-based tax rates on documents and journal postings for receivables, sales and output tax.

Details for GST-aware documents

Two portals, separate sign-ins

A Distributor portal for day-to-day operations and an Admin portal for head-office oversight. A Distributor sign-in never grants Admin access.

Details for Two portals, separate sign-ins

Distributor data isolation

Distributor routes are scoped to the signed-in Distributor and covered by cross-tenant automated tests.

Details for Distributor data isolation

Optional ERP integration

Connections, sync jobs, error monitoring and audit. Verified with simulated ERP responses; live-ERP verification is still pending.

Details for Optional ERP integration

Operational safeguards

Request rate limits, request-size limits, correlation IDs on every request and a health endpoint for load balancers.

Details for Operational safeguards
